title: Pediatric continuous seizure-event detection
disposition_reason: The complete 686-record/23-person normalized event evaluator and descriptive original-event alarm diagnostics are delivered. Authentic EEG preparation and a competent signal reference are not qualified; neither tolerant event F1 nor score-grid alignment establishes prompt onset detection.

scientific_target.question: From causal EEG alone, can a fixed detector recover annotated seizure-event presence across complete held-person monitoring, while limiting false alarms and predicted-positive occupancy?
scientific_target.known_answer: Recording-relative annotated seizure intervals, with separate raw annotations and processed intervals under the frozen timescoring merge/split/tolerance policy.
scientific_target.answer_origin: CHB-MIT 1.0.0 recording summaries and companion seizure annotation files; evaluator accepts normalized private intervals only after operator provenance review.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete EDF recording on an explicit 10 Hz prediction grid, nested within one held biological person.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 23 biological people; chb01 and chb21 are one person, not independent folds.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Public-development event-presence detection under a prospective causal observation policy; observed recording hours exclude inter-file gaps.
exclusions: Clinical utility or prospective seizure prediction
Timely onset detection inferred from a 30 s/60 s tolerant event score
Treating processed merge/split event counts as original clinical seizures

inputs: Selected genuine bipolar EEG channels with native calibration in microvolts and native sample-count/rate declarations; the checked representative source header is 256 Hz, but every file needs verification.
Complete causal samples through each 10 Hz bin endpoint; montage metadata required to interpret channels, not to recover labels.
forbidden_inputs: Summary seizure times, annotation channels and companion annotation files in participant inputs
Future samples, target-person labels, label-derived selection of monitoring windows
Source filename lookup or recording hashes used to retrieve public labels
observation_contract.case_identity: Evaluator requires all 686 pinned RECORDS paths, exact person aliases and fold identities. A future participant projection must use opaque identities while retaining an operator join.
observation_contract.split: Implemented policy specifies 23 leave-one-biological-person-out folds, with chb01/chb21 held together; preprocessing and inner selection are confined to the other 22 people. Physical fit compliance is not enforced by score validation.
observation_contract.coverage: All 686 recordings, including seizure-free background and every observed tick; no cross-record merge or invented time in acquisition gaps. Authentic normalized arrays remain unbound.

primary.name: patient_macro_event_f1
primary.aggregation: Sum processed event counts within each of the 23 people, compute person F1, then equal-person mean; undefined person F1 makes the primary null.
primary.rationale: Measures complete-monitoring event coverage; compulsory false alarms and occupancy expose long positive predictions that tolerance can reward.

secondary: Person-level and pooled event sensitivity, precision and false alarms per 24 observed hours
Unmerged sample F1, sensitivity, precision and predicted-positive time fraction

Descriptive original-event alarm onset state, within-record new-alarm tick offsets and no-raw-overlap flags; not measured online latency or tolerant false-negative counts. Early/late-only tolerant-credit attribution remains prospective.

comparators.name: All-negative and all-positive controls
comparators.procedure: Implemented constant controls; valid weak detectors, never silently rejected.

comparators.name: Causal EEG line-length detector
comparators.inputs: Only selected EEG and outer-training annotations
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed reference requiring native qualification and training-only threshold; not supplied as competent by this package.

comparators.name: Timing/montage-only detector
comparators.inputs: Elapsed time and admissible montage descriptors, no EEG
comparators.procedure: Proposed matched nuisance baseline with identical training folds and threshold selection.

nuisance_controls: Group chb01/chb21 at the biological identity level.
Freeze channel-role and duplicate-label resolution per file; remove marker/annotation channels.
Keep all seizure-free background and record-boundary resets.
Compare occupancy and unextended sample metrics because one long prediction may cover several tolerant reference events.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all 23 paired person contrasts to fixed references; a frozen patient-resampling scheme must acknowledge overlapping LOPO training sets. Current complete evaluator does not implement that paired uncertainty protocol.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject missing/duplicate recordings, wrong aliases/folds, score gaps/overlaps, nonfinite probabilities and threshold-inconsistent intervals. Preserve undefined person endpoints as null; never delete them from the macro.

implementation.scorer_target: core.evaluate scores normalized private reference intervals against complete candidate probabilities/events, including event/sample metrics and separate descriptive original-event alarm diagnostics. It does not load/authenticate EDF signals, train a detector or verify online decision timing.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete-support event-scoring source, descriptive original-event alarm diagnostics and generated full-roster engineering controls; no authentic signal-reference or participant run.
missing: Authenticate all selected EDF/header/annotation joins and normalize causal waveforms.
Execute fixed EEG and timing/montage comparators on complete held-person monitoring.
Freeze paired uncertainty and validate actual decision timing and early/late-only tolerant-credit attribution before timeliness claims; descriptive original-event alarm diagnostics are implemented.
Provision a participant transport with no label access.
implementation.execution_evidence: Reviewed source and generated controls, including the additive 39-method source campaign (14 new and 25 existing methods); no authentic EEG, model outcome or measured online decision latency.

direct_observation.representation: Rendered continuous EEG windows with fixed scales and declared surrounding causal context could support event annotation, but a complete-record no-tools response protocol is absent.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: A multichannel EEG viewer with bounded navigation is scientifically suitable for annotation; no typed viewer is delivered for this task.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: An investigator could analyze allowed EEG and submit complete probabilities, but this package delivers the evaluator rather than a case-investigation participant loop.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.

frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
